items.brief: Circle taps DBS so institutions can buy and redeem USDC as Asian banks build rival systems
items.why: Shows a bank-linked redemption channel for a major stablecoin in Asia.

items.brief: DBS lets eligible Asian institutions mint and redeem USDC around the clock
items.why: Expands 24/7 institutional minting and redemption access to a stablecoin.

items.brief: World Bank Group picks Circle and Citi to test stablecoin-based fund disbursements
items.why: Signals institutional testing of stablecoins for payment disbursement models.

items.brief: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by end of 2027
items.why: Points to expansion plans into tokenized lending and traditional finance.

items.brief: Ocree, Canadian Securities Exchange, Apex launch tokenized real estate pilot
items.why: Tests whether existing exchange, dealer and custody systems support tokenized private markets.

items.brief: Fed's Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance risks
items.why: Raises questions of fraud and key-compromise responsibility as assets move on-chain.

items.brief: Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at center of tokenization
items.why: Suggests the Fed could provide trusted rails for tokenized asset innovation.

items.brief: Alpaca says tokenization network tops $10 billion in minting and redemption volume
items.why: Reports cumulative minting and redemption volume on a tokenization network.

items.brief: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
items.why: Connects tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on central bank money work.

items.brief: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
items.why: Aims to link tokenized stockholders to disclosures and voting, without creating rights.
